name: happyface
description: happyface's plugins for GitHub Copilot: the spec workflow, Flutter conventions and decision reviews.

plugins.name: spec
plugins.description: A project specification as a graph of units, with a CLI and a ticket-driven workflow.

plugins.name: flutter
plugins.description: Flutter conventions, core rules and pattern skills (cubits, models, networking, forms, navigation, UI, tests).

plugins.name: decide
plugins.description: Make decisions on a visual page: each option is a picture of its result, with its cost.

plugins.name: visualize
plugins.description: Explain a concept, a change or something the agent did as a bold visual storyboard.

plugins.name: visualize-interactive
plugins.description: A visual storyboard you can question: click any part and a small, locked-down model answers from checked notes.
